newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton Energy files for 6.0 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton Energy files for 6.0 mln shr offer.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Monday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of six million of its common shares.
The company said it is offering 1.5 million of these shares and will use the proceeds to repay a portion of its outstanding bank debt incurred in acquisitions.
The selling shareholders, Odyssey Partners LP and several limited partnerships managed by First Reserve Corp are offering 4.5 million shares, it added.
The company said Odyssey Partners is dissolving, and Hugoton represents Odyssey's last remaining energy investment, it added.

First Reserve limited partnerships are selling about one-half of their shares of Hugoton common stock, it added. The shares these partnerships hold were acquired in September 1995 when Hugoton bought Consolidated Oil & Gas Inc for $35 million of cash and 9.1 million shares of Hugoton stock.
Salomon Brothers will be the managing underwriter with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Smith Barney Inc and Jeffries & Co Inc as co-managers.
Hugoton is an independent oil and natural gas company.
